paragraphs: Chizkiyah, father of Ikkesh, testified before Rabban Gamliel at Yavneh, saying [a teaching] in the name of Rabban Gamliel the Elder: Bekhorot 38a, beginning. In Sifra, portion Shemini, on “anything of them that falls into it,” he testified before Rabban Gamliel the Elder. In Yalkut Shemini, end of section 539, the name is Chizkiyah Ish Ikkesh.
